releaseNotes:
• Custom Players Per Side: Support for 5s, 6s, 7s, 8s, 11s or custom team sizes (box & gully cricket)
• Dynamic all-out wickets: innings ends automatically at (Players - 1) wickets
• Custom victory margins (e.g. won by X wickets in custom player matches)
• Real-time Active Users corner badge and presence synchronization
• 100% accurate cricket rule compliance (MCC Laws)
• Run out attribution, maiden overs, byes & leg byes
• Free Hit alert banner on No-Ball
